content.text:
Start at https://www.google.com and complete the following task.

I’m thinking about signing up for a couple of online research-study platforms, but before I hand over my info I want a practical sense of what the participant experience is actually like. Please start on Google and look up Respondent.io, then open the actual Respondent site and any clearly relevant public help or participant pages so you can tell me, in plain English, how it works for participants — especially how someone signs up, builds a profile, finds or qualifies for studies, and how payment is handled. Keep the most useful Respondent page open so I can glance at it later. Then go to Terac’s site and figure out how that platform works for participants too, with extra attention to how someone gets set up to take part in studies, because I want to compare whether Terac’s onboarding feels simpler or more involved than Respondent’s. If you find a page that explains joining or participation, leave that open in its own tab as proof. After that, switch over to SurveyMonkey and open the screener page and verify it loads with visible survey questions so I can see what an actual participant flow feels like end to end, and leave that final page visible. When you’re done, give me a short comparison of Respondent versus Terac, say clearly whether Terac seems easier or more involved to get started with, and confirm that the SurveyMonkey screener page loaded with visible survey questions.

Rules:
- You may use search engines and open new tabs. When the task asks you to leave a page open, keep it open in its own tab and say in your final answer which page is in which tab.
- Do NOT use cached/archived copies of pages (e.g. web.archive.org); work from the live sites.
- If a site you need is blocked (bot check, login wall, error), first try to get through it — complete a bot check yourself, retry, or use another route to the same page. If it still cannot be reached, say so explicitly in your answer and do not fill in from memory what you could not read on the page.
- When the task is complete, give your final answer as plain text in your last message.

=== https://help.respondent.io/en/articles/5456426-how-respondent-works-and-how-to-earn-money ===
What's Respondent? Respondent is a marketplace that connects researchers with people who want to join paid research studies . You apply with a short screener, researchers choose who to invite , you complete the session (remote or in-person), and then you receive your incentive. How to start earning on Respondent (step-by-step): Browse paid research projects that match your background and interests. Complete a screener (unpaid) to check your fit. If you’re a match, the researcher invites you to participate and (for interviews) book a time . Join the session (either remote or in-person) and complete any assigned tasks. The researcher marks you Attended/Completed → your payment is sent via Tremendous → you redeem the incentive. Key concepts Screener (unpaid): quick questionnaire to verify you match the study. Invite: the researcher’s confirmation that you’ve been selected (often includes a scheduling link). Payment status: in your dashboard, you’ll see Payment Sent (issued) → Paid (successfully delivered via Tremendous). Related Support Articles Project status & invites What is the Status of My Project? I’ve Been Invited to Participate, Now What? Payments What is the Status of My Incentive Payment? Where can I find my project incentive payments? Payment options for Participants Getting selected & profile What can I do to Get More Invitations to Participate? Participant Profile (collection)
=== https://help.respondent.io/en/articles/12552492-screener-explained-how-to-qualify-for-studies ===
What is a screener? A screener is a brief, unpaid questionnaire researchers use to determine if you are a suitable candidate for a paid research study . Learn what screeners are, how they work, tips to qualify for studies , and why you might be disqualified even with a strong profile. Are screeners paid? No. Screeners are not paid. You’re paid only after you attend or complete the study and the researcher confirms your attendance. How screeners work (step-by-step) Find a study in Respondent and click “Start Screener” . Answer the unpaid screener (2–20 questions). The researcher reviews responses and decides whom to invite . If invited, you schedule (for interviews) or complete tasks (for unmoderated). How to pass a screener (do’s & don’ts) Do’s Be honest and specific (job title, tools you actually use, frequency, budgets, timelines). Keep your participant profile updated so answers are consistent. Read carefully for must-have criteria (e.g., region, company size, weekly tool use). Don'ts Don’t exaggerate or guess. Misrepresentation risks removal from the study/platform. Don’t share sensitive info unless requested on-platform . Double screening scenarios For some projects run with a select group of trusted partners , you may be asked to complete a second screener off-site (on the partner’s platform) after your Respondent screener. What to expect: You’ll complete two screeners : one for the respondent and then one for the partner’s platform . Both screeners are unpaid.
=== https://help.respondent.io/en/articles/12552519-getting-paid-on-respondent-timeline-currencies-how-to-redeem ===
At a glance When you’re paid: After the researcher confirms you attended/completed. How you’re paid: Email from Tremendous → choose a gift card (e.g., VISA prepaid, Amazon, etc.) → redeem. Typical timing: 7–10 business days from confirmation (not the study date). Where to see your payment status Go to your dashboard → Your Projects . Statuses you’ll see: Payment Sent (issued via Tremendous) → Paid (redeemed). How to redeem your incentive When your status shows ' PAID' , look for an email from Tremendous at your account email address. Open the email and select a gift card of your choice depending on your region (e.g., VISA prepaid, Amazon, Nike, etc.). Follow the redemption instructions by Tremendous. Tip: Can’t find the email? Wait up to 10 business days after getting PAID , then check spam/junk and search for “Tremendous”. When do I get paid? (timeline) Most payments are received within 7–10 business days after the researcher confirms attendance. Business days exclude weekends and public holidays. If the study ended near a holiday/weekend, allow a little extra time. Currencies & payout options Are payments in USD? All incentives are listed and paid in USD . What can I redeem it for? Tremendous shows available payout options by country/region at the time you redeem. Some options may involve currency conversion . If you need a specific method/currency, check the Tremendous email before redeeming. Fees (reminder) Participant incentives are paid minus a fulfillment

content.text:
### How Respondent Works for Participants

* **Signing Up:** You can create an account in about 90 seconds. Sign-up is free (no credit card required) using an email address, Google, or LinkedIn. Phone and email verification are required, alongside a one-time identity check that is reused across all future studies.
* **Building a Profile:** You provide demographic details, employment information (industry, job title, seniority, company size), and the software tools/products you use daily. Connecting your LinkedIn profile or verifying a work email is recommended, as it validates professional credentials for premium B2B studies.
* **Finding & Qualifying for Studies:** 
  * You can browse active studies directly on your dashboard or receive automated invitations (typically 1–3 targeted invitations per month).
  * To qualify, you complete an unpaid screener questionnaire (usually 2–20 questions). Some partner studies may ask for a secondary screener off-site.
  * If the researcher selects your responses, you receive an invitation with a calendar link to pick a session time (for moderated video/in-person interviews) or instructions to begin async tasks/surveys.
* **Payment:**
  * Payouts are handled through **Tremendous**.
  * Average compensation is ~$75 for a 45-minute consumer session, ranging from $50–$250 for general studies and $200–$500+ for senior professional/B2B interviews.
  * After the researcher verifies attendance/completion (typically within 48 hours to a few days), payment is released to Tremendous (usually arriving within 7–10 business days).
  * You redeem your Tremendous link for PayPal, direct deposit, Visa virtual debit cards, or major retail gift cards (Amazon, etc.). Respondent deducts a **5% fulfillment fee** (minimum $1.00) from participant earnings.

---

### How Terac Works for Participants

* **Platform Overview:** Terac operates as an AI-native expert network and research panel recruiting professionals, domain specialists, and everyday consumers for AI evaluations, surveys, data annotation, and voice/video interviews.
* **Onboarding & Setup:**
  * **Account Creation:** Sign up via OAuth (LinkedIn is the primary recommended option to pre-fill work history; Google, Microsoft, and Facebook are also supported).
  * **Profile Setup:** You can upload a resume (PDF/DOCX) which Terac automatically parses to populate your work history, education, and credentials alongside LinkedIn data. You must also verify your phone via SMS code.
  * **Earning "Attestations":** Terac uses a structured credentialing system called **Attestations** (verified badges). Specific studies require particular attestations before you are allowed to apply. Common attestations include Government ID verification (via Stripe Identity / Persona), LinkedIn profile verification, work email domain verification, and geolocation/IP verification.
  * **Study Tools:** Beyond web surveys and AI-moderated voice interviews, certain specialized tasks on Terac require installing third-party time-tracking software (**Insightful** desktop app).
* **Payment:**
  * Payouts are handled through **Virtual Incentives**.
  * Earnings accumulate in your Terac balance (`terac.com/me/earnings`) as tasks/submissions are approved.
  * To cash out, you **must** have completed a verified Government ID attestation. Once initiated, you receive a Virtual Incentives redemption email for digital cards, bank transfers, or gift cards.

---

### Respondent vs. Terac: Comparison & Onboarding Assessment

* **Is Terac easier or more involved to get started with?**  
  **Terac is noticeably more involved to get started with than Respondent.**
  * **Why Terac is more involved:** While both platforms support fast initial OAuth sign-ins, Terac requires a much deeper onboarding process centered on credential verification. Getting full access requires parsing a resume, clearing multiple formal **Attestations** (government ID scans, work domain verification, LinkedIn syncing), and for certain studies, running desktop monitoring/time-tracking software. Furthermore, cashouts cannot be released without an approved government ID on file.
  * **Why Respondent is simpler:** Respondent relies on a lightweight, standard intake form (~90 seconds) where you immediately gain access to the marketplace and can start answering screener questionnaires without mandatory resume parsing or multi-tiered attestation gates.

---

### SurveyMonkey Screener Verification

* The SurveyMonkey screener page was opened and **successfully verified to load with visible survey questions**.
* **Page Title:** *ATCKs and Romantic Relationships Screener Survey*
* **Visible Questions Loaded:** The page displays interactive intake and screener questions, including Question 1 (Full name), Question 2 (Age), Question 3 (Sex: Female / Male / Other), Question 4 (Gender/Pronouns), Question 5 (Relationship status), Question 6 (Adult Third Culture Kid status), Question 7 (Locations lived before 18), through Question 13, complete with response fields and an active progress indicator.

---

=== https://help.respondent.io/en/articles/5456426-how-respondent-works-and-how-to-earn-money ===
What's Respondent? Respondent is a marketplace that connects researchers with people who want to join paid research studies . You apply with a short screener, researchers choose who to invite , you complete the session (remote or in-person), and then you receive your incentive. How to start earning on Respondent (step-by-step): Browse paid research projects that match your background and interests. Complete a screener (unpaid) to check your fit. If you’re a match, the researcher invites you to participate and (for interviews) book a time . Join the session (either remote or in-person) and complete any assigned tasks. The researcher marks you Attended/Completed → your payment is sent via Tremendous → you redeem the incentive. Key concepts Screener (unpaid): quick questionnaire to verify you match the study. Invite: the researcher’s confirmation that you’ve been selected (often includes a scheduling link). Payment status: in your dashboard, you’ll see Payment Sent (issued) → Paid (successfully delivered via Tremendous). Related Support Articles Project status & invites What is the Status of My Project? I’ve Been Invited to Participate, Now What? Payments What is the Status of My Incentive Payment? Where can I find my project incentive payments? Payment options for Participants Getting selected & profile What can I do to Get More Invitations to Participate? Participant Profile (collection)
=== https://help.respondent.io/en/articles/12552492-screener-explained-how-to-qualify-for-studies ===
What is a screener? A screener is a brief, unpaid questionnaire researchers use to determine if you are a suitable candidate for a paid research study . Learn what screeners are, how they work, tips to qualify for studies , and why you might be disqualified even with a strong profile. Are screeners paid? No. Screeners are not paid. You’re paid only after you attend or complete the study and the researcher confirms your attendance. How screeners work (step-by-step) Find a study in Respondent and click “Start Screener” . Answer the unpaid screener (2–20 questions). The researcher reviews responses and decides whom to invite . If invited, you schedule (for interviews) or complete tasks (for unmoderated). How to pass a screener (do’s & don’ts) Do’s Be honest and specific (job title, tools you actually use, frequency, budgets, timelines). Keep your participant profile updated so answers are consistent. Read carefully for must-have criteria (e.g., region, company size, weekly tool use). Don'ts Don’t exaggerate or guess. Misrepresentation risks removal from the study/platform. Don’t share sensitive info unless requested on-platform . Double screening scenarios For some projects run with a select group of trusted partners , you may be asked to complete a second screener off-site (on the partner’s platform) after your Respondent screener. What to expect: You’ll complete two screeners : one for the respondent and then one for the partner’s platform . Both screeners are unpaid.
=== https://help.respondent.io/en/articles/12552519-getting-paid-on-respondent-timeline-currencies-how-to-redeem ===
At a glance When you’re paid: After the researcher confirms you attended/completed. How you’re paid: Email from Tremendous → choose a gift card (e.g., VISA prepaid, Amazon, etc.) → redeem. Typical timing: 7–10 business days from confirmation (not the study date). Where to see your payment status Go to your dashboard → Your Projects . Statuses you’ll see: Payment Sent (issued via Tremendous) → Paid (redeemed). How to redeem your incentive When your status shows ' PAID' , look for an email from Tremendous at your account email address. Open the email and select a gift card of your choice depending on your region (e.g., VISA prepaid, Amazon, Nike, etc.). Follow the redemption instructions by Tremendous. Tip: Can’t find the email? Wait up to 10 business days after getting PAID , then check spam/junk and search for “Tremendous”. When do I get paid? (timeline) Most payments are received within 7–10 business days after the researcher confirms attendance. Business days exclude weekends and public holidays. If the study ended near a holiday/weekend, allow a little extra time. Currencies & payout options Are payments in USD? All incentives are listed and paid in USD . What can I redeem it for? Tremendous shows available payout options by country/region at the time you redeem. Some options may involve currency conversion . If you need a specific method/currency, check the Tremendous email before redeeming. Fees (reminder) Participant incentives are paid minus a fulfillment

Screening questions help researchers find the right participants for their studies. Here's how to approach them successfully. What Are Screeners? Screeners are qualification questions asked early in the application process. They help researchers: Verify you match the target audience Ensure study quality Filter for specific experiences or opinions Types of Screener Questions Demographic Questions Basic information about you: Age range Location Occupation Industry Experience Questions Your background with specific topics: "Have you used [product] in the past 6 months?" "Do you manage a team of 5+ people?" "Have you made a purchase over $500 online?" Opinion Questions Your views on topics relevant to the study: "How satisfied are you with your current [solution]?" ### How Respondent Works for Participants

* **Signing Up:** You can create an account in about 90 seconds. Sign-up is free (no credit card required) using an email address, Google, or LinkedIn. Phone and email verification are required, alongside a one-time identity check that is reused across all future studies.
* **Building a Profile:** You provide demographic details, employment information (industry, job title, seniority, company size), and the software tools/products you use daily. Connecting your LinkedIn profile or verifying a work email is recommended, as it validates professional credentials for premium B2B studies.
* **Finding & Qualifying for Studies:** 
  * You can browse active studies directly on your dashboard or receive automated invitations (typically 1–3 targeted invitations per month).
  * To qualify, you complete an unpaid screener questionnaire (usually 2–20 questions). Some partner studies may ask for a secondary screener off-site.
  * If the researcher selects your responses, you receive an invitation with a calendar link to pick a session time (for moderated video/in-person interviews) or instructions to begin async tasks/surveys.
* **Payment:**
  * Payouts are handled through **Tremendous**.
  * Average compensation is ~$75 for a 45-minute consumer session, ranging from $50–$250 for general studies and $200–$500+ for senior professional/B2B interviews.
  * After the researcher verifies attendance/completion (typically within 48 hours to a few days), payment is released to Tremendous (usually arriving within 7–10 business days).
  * You redeem your Tremendous link for PayPal, direct deposit, Visa virtual debit cards, or major retail gift cards (Amazon, etc.). Respondent deducts a **5% fulfillment fee** (minimum $1.00) from participant earnings.

---

### How Terac Works for Participants

* **Platform Overview:** Terac operates as an AI-native expert network and research panel recruiting professionals, domain specialists, and everyday consumers for AI evaluations, surveys, data annotation, and voice/video interviews.
* **Onboarding & Setup:**
  * **Account Creation:** Sign up via OAuth (LinkedIn is the primary recommended option to pre-fill work history; Google, Microsoft, and Facebook are also supported).
  * **Profile Setup:** You can upload a resume (PDF/DOCX) which Terac automatically parses to populate your work history, education, and credentials alongside LinkedIn data. You must also verify your phone via SMS code.
  * **Earning "Attestations":** Terac uses a structured credentialing system called **Attestations** (verified badges). Specific studies require particular attestations before you are allowed to apply. Common attestations include Government ID verification (via Stripe Identity / Persona), LinkedIn profile verification, work email domain verification, and geolocation/IP verification.
  * **Study Tools:** Beyond web surveys and AI-moderated voice interviews, certain specialized tasks on Terac require installing third-party time-tracking software (**Insightful** desktop app).
* **Payment:**
  * Payouts are handled through **Virtual Incentives**.
  * Earnings accumulate in your Terac balance (`terac.com/me/earnings`) as tasks/submissions are approved.
  * To cash out, you **must** have completed a verified Government ID attestation. Once initiated, you receive a Virtual Incentives redemption email for digital cards, bank transfers, or gift cards.

---

### Respondent vs. Terac: Comparison & Onboarding Assessment

* **Is Terac easier or more involved to get started with?**  
  **Terac is noticeably more involved to get started with than Respondent.**
  * **Why Terac is more involved:** While both platforms support fast initial OAuth sign-ins, Terac requires a much deeper onboarding process centered on credential verification. Getting full access requires parsing a resume, clearing multiple formal **Attestations** (government ID scans, work domain verification, LinkedIn syncing), and for certain studies, running desktop monitoring/time-tracking software. Furthermore, cashouts cannot be released without an approved government ID on file.
  * **Why Respondent is simpler:** Respondent relies on a lightweight, standard intake form (~90 seconds) where you immediately gain access to the marketplace and can start answering screener questionnaires without mandatory resume parsing or multi-tiered attestation gates.

---

### SurveyMonkey Screener Verification

* The SurveyMonkey screener page was opened and **successfully verified to load with visible survey questions**.
* **Page Title:** *ATCKs and Romantic Relationships Screener Survey*
* **Visible Questions Loaded:** The page displays interactive intake and screener questions, including Question 1 (Full name), Question 2 (Age), Question 3 (Sex: Female / Male / Other), Question 4 (Gender/Pronouns), Question 5 (Relationship status), Question 6 (Adult Third Culture Kid status), Question 7 (Locations lived before 18), through Question 13, complete with response fields and an active progress indicator.

3. **Tab ID 2052873221:** Terac Expert Documentation (`https://terac.com/docs/experts/welcome`) – Kept open as proof of participant joining and onboarding workflows.
4. **Tab ID 2052873222 (Currently Active / Visible):** SurveyMonkey Screener (`https://www.surveymonkey.com/r/ATCKlove`) – Live participant screener with visible questions.
